reviews.author: Geeta Mallam
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience!
We have been visiting Andhra Vindhu since last year for its authentic Andhra taste, but today every single non-veg dish was bland and tasteless—Karivepaku Chicken, Prawns, Gongura Mutton and Fish Curry. Not one had proper salt or spices, and the flavours had not penetrated the meat or fish.
Management, this is basic Andhra cooking! If customers wanted bland, diet food, we could eat at home. We come here for the authentic, spicy Andhra flavours.
Please seriously question the cook and your quality control. When every dish is under-seasoned, it is not a one-off mistake—it is a clear failure in the kitchen. Don’t compromise the taste that brought your regular customers back. You have spoiled our birthday celebration.

reviews.author: Lijo Chacko
reviews.text: The experience was average overall. The service was the best part—staff were attentive and courteous. The food was decent, and the authentic Andhra-style spice level was enjoyable. However, many items on the menu were unavailable, and the beverage options were quite limited. Also, despite specifically requesting some dishes to be made less spicy, they were still served spicy. The ambience was okay, but better menu availability and attention to customer preferences would improve the overall experience.

We visited Andhra Vindu on Sunday around 4:30 PM. The place is very spacious and comfortable, making it a good spot to relax and enjoy food without feeling crowded.

The service was good and the staff were attentive. We tried biryani along with some starters — the taste was really good and satisfying. The prices are also reasonable and not too high compared to the quality and quantity they serve.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience, and I would definitely recommend this place for good Andhra-style food with a comfortable dining atmosphere.

reviews.author: People Lens
reviews.text: I visited Andra Vindu Multicuisine Restaurant and ordered the meals, and the experience was truly amazing. The food tasted exactly like original home-cooked food, full of authentic flavors and freshness. The meals were unlimited and very satisfying, making it great value for money. Every item felt well prepared and comforting. If you love traditional, homemade-style meals, I highly recommend everyone to visit and experience this place at least once. 😊🍽️
